title: Fort Témiscamingue Trade Store

terrainReference.basis: Original ground on the shore side of the historic store estimate.

mapIdentity.provider: Parks Canada site inventory and an OpenStreetMap named trading-post interpretation feature
mapIdentity.scope: Parks Canada identifies the store at the southwest end of the historic group. The mapped fur trade diorama supplies an estimate of its location and main axis. It is interpreted with the historic two-store group identified by Roy and Drouin and the large shore-side gabled mass in the 1876 Qualla photograph.

note: The 1876 photograph indicates a simple long gabled store near the western shore. The 1888 camp has two stores documented by Roy. This asset represents the western one.
